scope: Orientação opcional, automática e reversível nos arquivos globais dos agentes compatíveis

tests.source: Frozen Git index artifact, absolute pytest pythonpath, managed ./dev environments

resource_observation.limit: bounded sample window, not a stability soak or physical cause diagnosis

contracts: Default off on new installations; this host is explicitly enabled during installation
Bounded configured-client discovery while Folego is open, every three minutes
Only the marked Folego insertion is added or removed; personal instructions and later edits remain
Intent and original bytes precede effects; coordinator, readback and same-ID reconciliation
Unknown schema, ambiguous blocks, unsafe ownership/links/permissions and uncertain effects preserve instructions
Periodic worker does not allocate a new subprocess temporary tree every cycle
No agent restart, grants expansion or kernel resource enforcement
